description: Web Interface Completion - Full daemon integration, real-time updates, and all missing features

userStories.title: WebSocket reconnection with exponential backoff
userStories.description: As a user, I want the web UI to automatically reconnect to the daemon when connection drops.
acceptanceCriteria: Exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, max 30s between attempts
Show Reconnecting... status in header when disconnected
Display connection status indicator: green=connected, red=disconnected, yellow=reconnecting
Max 10 reconnection attempts before showing Daemon offline message
Automatically resume when daemon comes back online
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: Implemented in useEventBus hook with calculateBackoff function. Updated SwissMissionControl and MissionControl to show connectionStatus with color indicators.

userStories.title: Real-time wave progress visualization
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see wave execution progress in real-time on The Coil component.
acceptanceCriteria: Each wave card shows progress bar with percentage
Task count updates as tasks complete
Status badges update: pending -> active -> done/failed
Wave cards animate when status changes using Framer Motion
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: Added progress bar, completed/total task count, and status change animations. Used motion.div with initial/animate/exit for wave cards.

userStories.title: Task detail panel
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click a task to see its details in a side panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Click task opens slide-in panel from right with Framer Motion
Panel shows: task ID, description, status, created/updated timestamps
Panel shows execution logs for the task
Panel has Retry button for failed tasks
Panel closes on ESC key or click outside
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: Created TaskDetailPanel component with slide-in animation. Added task click event dispatcher in TheCoil. Updated Task type with description and timestamps.

userStories.title: Settings page - theme selector
userStories.description: As a user, I want to switch between Snake and Swiss themes from settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings page has theme radio buttons: Snake | Swiss
Theme preference saved to localStorage
Theme persists across page reloads
Immediate visual update on selection
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: Added uiLayout setting to settings-store with snake/swiss options. Updated Settings page with UI Layout selector. App.tsx now renders correct component based on setting.

userStories.title: Settings page - daemon configuration
userStories.description: As a user, I want to configure daemon connection settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Input field for daemon WebSocket URL (default: ws://localhost:7777)
Input field for API key (optional, password type)
Test Connection button with success/error feedback
Settings saved to localStorage
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: Added daemonConfig to settings-store with websocketUrl and apiKey. Added Daemon Connection section to Settings page with test connection button.
